about: BUZZY's facts for the redesign chrome (main session). Every value is copied from the live getbuzzy.com pages captured 2026-11-05 (audit/raw/buzzy/, text in tmp/txt/). Where the live site contradicts itself, the chrome uses the delivery hub's own summary line; the conflicts are listed in docs/OPEN-DECISIONS.md.
